facts.text: Born: 23 January 1897; died: 18 August 1945, air crash near Taihoku (Taiwan)
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: 125th birth anniversary: 23 January 2022 — statue near India Gate (sculptor Arun Yogiraj)
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Slogans: "Give me blood, and I will give you freedom"; "Chalo Dilli", "Jai Hind"
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Organisations: Forward Bloc (founded 3 May 1939); Indian National Army (1943–45)
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Newspapers: Swaraj (founder), Forward (editor); book: The Indian Struggle
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Congress President: Haripura (1938) and Tripuri (1939) sessions; 1930 Mayor of Calcutta
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Azad Hind Government: 21 October 1943, Singapore — recognised by 9 countries; Bose was PM, Foreign and Defence Minister
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: 30 December 1943: Tricolour hoisted at Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: 6 July 1944: first to call Gandhi "Father of the Nation" (radio, Singapore)
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: 2018: Ross Island renamed Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island; 2021: birthday declared Parakram Diwas
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: ⚠ Bharat Ratna 1992 (posthumous) withdrawn in 1997 — the only such case
facts.head: Background — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose

facts.text: Azad Hind Fauj: originally formed 29 October 1915 by Raja Mahendra Pratap Singh, Rash Behari Bose, Niranjan Singh Gill; INA handed to Bose by Rash Behari Bose (4 July 1943)
